subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Describe, compare and order numbers to 999
source.subtopic: Describe and compare numbers to 700 (weeks 1-2), 800 (weeks 3-4), 900 (weeks 5-6) and 999 (weeks 7-10): smaller than, greater than

show.line: Which is greater, 867 or 876? Same hundreds. Look at the tens. Seven tens beat six tens. 876!

rounds.praise: Yes! Two tens beat one ten.

rounds.prompt: Which is smaller, 899 or 900? Say the number.
Which list is in order from smallest to greatest?
Which number is ten more than 590?
Smaller than 800 or greater than 800? Sort the numbers.

hints: Hundreds first. If they match, look at the tens. Then the ones.
The crocodile mouth opens towards the bigger number.

beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: 999 is greater, because it has three nines!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! 1000 has four digits. It comes after 999, so it is greater.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count on together. 998, 999, 1000. One thousand is greater!

parent_line: Can compare and order numbers up to 999.
